title: Studio: Customize on a list view the deployment created in the console declares an override of the read-only base and the save answers 403 ("ships no view named …"), so such a view cannot be edited in Studio (item 2 of #34908)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUgZpbKcVYFC7iXgMu

carries item 2 of #34908; #34908 keeps item 1 (view audiences by position / role / permission set).

Filing gate: split of a triaged card, as its first touch directed (6953426292, quoted verbatim): "(2) A console-created view answering 403 when customized in Studio is a bug. If its cause is separate, the claiming dev splits (2) out on its own card at p1." Grade p1 taken from that comment. Area: build.

## What happens (reported on #34908, 18.5.0, measured in a browser by its author)

In Studio, using 「定制」 (Customize) on a list view that was created through the console's 新建视图, and then adding a column, fails on save:

> 403 'view/crm_account.yanzheng_yong_guonei_kehu_shitu' declares an override of 'com.steedos.blackcat.crm', which ships no view named …

A view the deployment created itself cannot be edited in Studio.

## Why the cause is separate from item 1 (read at `origin/main` `e35cf035`, not driven in a browser)

- The sentence is the server's `shipsNoSuchItemMessage` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts:1142-1172`): an item that declares `overrides` of a base that ships no item of that name is refused, with the remedy "Remove `overrides` to keep it as '<package>''s own item, or correct the name (ADR-0146 D2)". That refusal reads correct for the body it was sent.
- The body comes from Studio's Customize flow (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioCustomizeControls.tsx`, `overrideDraftBody`, ADR-0146 D2/D3, #28562), which writes the item into the base's pair `<base>.custom` declaring `overrides: { package, basedOn }`. Offering Customize — and stamping `overrides` — on a view the base does not ship is the suspected defect: the item is the deployment's own, so it should be edited in place (or Customize should not be offered for it).
- Item 1 of #34908 is a new view capability (an audience); nothing in it touches this save path.

Not measured here: where the console's 新建视图 stores the view (which package / address), and which fact Studio reads to decide that the view is the base's. The claiming dev measures both before choosing the fix.

## Expected

Studio edits a deployment-created view in place, or does not offer Customize on it and says where it is edited, instead of failing with an override error (#34908, Expected 2).

Dedupe: issue search `Customize override ships no view`, `console view Studio 403 override`, `overrideDraftBody`, `ships no view named` → the only open hit on this defect is #34908; the closed hits (#28569, #28570, #29567, …) are other Customize cards.
